description.name: Attach Poison with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Leila (Poison)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Buccaneers' Brigrade (0~2), removed after using Buccaneers' Brigade two times

description.name: Buccaneers' Brigade Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Buccaneers' Brigade level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Leila (Poison)]

description.name: Buccaneers' Brigade Level
description.text: Keeps track of Buccaneers' Brigrade level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Leila (Poison)]
